short: Metal Organic Framework-Derived Metal Phosphates as Electrod
title: Metal Organic Framework-Derived Metal Phosphates as Electrode Materials for Supercapacitors

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Supercapacitor electrodes need higher specific capacitance and rate capability than pristine Ni-MOF provides. Replacing Ni-MOF's BTC linkers by phosphate should keep the MOF rod template while raising conductivity and capacitance.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/route), n5 (PRC/synthesis)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: BTC carboxylate linkers are replaced by PO4 units (P-O, O-P-O bonds) in NixPyOz. NixPyOz keeps the Ni-MOF micro-rod outline, with expanded rods and rough, loosened surfaces
states.detail: Absorbed: n6 (STR/chemistry/bonding), n8 (STR/microstructure/shape). Premises: BTC carboxylate stretches 1565/1436/1373 cm-1, coordinated water 1624 cm-1; P-O stretch 1120-910, O-P-O bend 600-530 cm-1

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: NixPyOz electrode film is more conductive than Ni-MOF film. NixPyOz electrode has lower charge-transfer resistance and faster ion diffusion than Ni-MOF.
states.detail: Absorbed: n9 (PRP/value), n10 (PRP/value), n11 (MEC/pathway). Premises: Smaller Nyquist semicircle means lower charge-transfer resistance; steeper low-frequency rise means faster ion diffusion; Loosely bound structures shorten ion diffusion length, raise ion uptake and accommodate redox volume change

states.title: Performance state
states.head: NixPyOz reaches ~1620 F/g at 1 A/g, about four times Ni-MOF (~400 F/g). NixPyOz keeps ~64% of its capacitance from 1 to 20 A/g versus ~21% for Ni-MOF.

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: MOF-derived NixPyOz from ligand substitution outperforms Ni-MOF in conductivity, capacitance and rate capability as supercapacitor electrode

nodes.title: THERMAL:TGA, F2
nodes.head: Ni-MOF carboxylate bands (1565, 1436, 1338 cm-1) and 1624 cm-1 water band are absent in NixPyOz. NixPyOz bands at 1113, 1010, 938, 911 cm-1 and 620, 530 cm-1 assigned to P-O stretch and O-P-O bend.
nodes.solves: BTC carboxylate linkers are replaced by PO4 units (P-O, O-P-O bonds) in NixPyOz
nodes.note: Band positions are author labels on the panel; panel labels 1338 cm-1 where linked text says 1373 cm-1. Weak residual features near 1600 and 1450 cm-1 remain in the NixPyOz trace. Judge: the NixPyOz trace sits at the sub-panel floor from ~1700 to ~1150 cm-1, so absence of carboxylate bands cannot be separated from saturated absorption. Linked text says NixPyOz loses 7% at 450-550 C; trace shows ~2-3% there. NixPyOz loses weight from 30 C while Ni-MOF is flat to ~120 C.
nodes.detail: o1: Ni-MOF carboxylate bands (1565, 1436, 1338 cm-1) and 1624 cm-1 water band are absent in NixPyOz; o2: NixPyOz bands at 1113, 1010, 938, 911 cm-1 and 620, 530 cm-1 assigned to P-O stretch and O-P-O bend; o3: Ni-MOF TGA shows a ~60% step at ~430-470 C (residue ~12%); NixPyOz has no such step, retaining ~75%
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n6 (o2, o3).

nodes.title: ECHEM:EIS, F5
nodes.head: Nyquist: NixPyOz has a smaller high-frequency semicircle (inset) and steeper low-Z' rise than Ni-MOF
nodes.solves: NixPyOz electrode has lower charge-transfer resistance and faster ion diffusion than Ni-MOF
nodes.note: Ni-MOF main arc spans ~1.5-10 ohm; NixPyOz curve does not close within 14 ohm. Judge: only the inset high-frequency arc is smaller for NixPyOz (onset ~0.95 vs ~1.25 ohm, MOF arc to ~1.5 ohm); the main plot shows a LARGER NixPyOz arc (Z'' ~12 ohm at Z' 14 ohm) than the MOF arc (Z'' max ~4.6 ohm), so the low-frequency reading does not show faster diffusion as a Warburg line.
nodes.detail: o10: Nyquist: NixPyOz has a smaller high-frequency semicircle (inset) and steeper low-Z' rise than Ni-MOF
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown and n10 has no other figure-backed support.

nodes.title: ECHEM:CV, F5
nodes.head: Both CV sets show one redox pair: cathodic ~0.15-0.27 V, anodic ~0.33-0.42 V. Redox peak currents grow with sweep rate from 1 to 100 mV/s in both electrodes.
nodes.op: assign features, convert to quantity, read trend
nodes.note: Judge: panel b cathodic peaks sit at ~0.21 V (100 mV/s) to ~0.27 V (10-25 mV/s); at 50-100 mV/s the anodic peak runs past the 0.45 V window. NixPyOz peak currents ~0.2 vs ~0.12 A/g at 100 mV/s for Ni-MOF (sample mapping per caption). Judge: 100 mV/s anodic values are window-end currents, not resolved peaks; cathodic peaks are nearly equal between the two electrodes (~-0.10 vs ~-0.11 A/g). Panel d shows one curve set only although its caption names both MOF and NixPyOz; its times match NixPyOz.
nodes.detail: o11: Both CV sets show one redox pair: cathodic ~0.15-0.27 V, anodic ~0.33-0.42 V; o12: Redox peak currents grow with sweep rate from 1 to 100 mV/s in both electrodes; o13: Discharge time at 1 A/g over 0.45 V: ~180 s in panel c versus ~730 s in panel d

nodes.title: ECHEM:CV, F5
nodes.head: Capacitance at 1 A/g ~1620 F/g for NixPyOz versus ~400 F/g for Ni-MOF. CV currents of NixPyOz exceed Ni-MOF by well under 2x at equal sweep rates, while GCD discharge times differ ~4x
nodes.solves: NixPyOz reaches ~1620 F/g at 1 A/g, about four times Ni-MOF (~400 F/g)
nodes.op: cross check consistency, read characteristic point
nodes.note: 1 A x 180 s / 0.45 V = 400 F/g and 1 x 730 / 0.45 = 1620 F/g agree with the plotted values. 10 mV/s: anodic peak ~0.04 (a) vs ~0.065 A/g (b), cathodic ~-0.03 vs ~-0.045 A/g; loop areas differ ~1.5x. GCD at 1 A/g: ~180 s (c) vs ~730 s (d).
nodes.detail: o14: Capacitance at 1 A/g ~1620 F/g for NixPyOz versus ~400 F/g for Ni-MOF; o18: CV currents of NixPyOz exceed Ni-MOF by well under 2x at equal sweep rates, while GCD discharge times differ ~4x
